TotalIssuedNominalAmount.name: Total Issued Nominal Amount
TotalIssuedNominalAmount.definition: Total issued nominal amount in monetary value.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Maturity date of the financial instrument.

NominalValuePerUnit.name: Nominal Value Per Unit
NominalValuePerUnit.definition: Nominal value of each instrument. If not available, the minimum traded value should be populated.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Interest rate of the debt instrument.

DebtSeniority.name: Debt Seniority
DebtSeniority.definition: Seniority for a specific debt instrument.
